name: development-flow
description: A commitment-aware software development workflow for research spikes, proofs of concept, MVPs, and production systems.

interface.shortDescription: Match engineering rigor to what you are building.
interface.longDescription: Choose between Research Spike, PoC, MVP, and Production lanes; research before implementation; plan by milestones and stable contracts; use controlled sequential writer handoffs only under context pressure; keep explorers and reviewers read-only; and produce evidence-backed executive reviews.
defaultPrompt: Choose the right development lane for this work.
Research and design this before implementation.
Review whether these tests protect stable contracts.
